title: Variants Not Pursued

variants_not_pursued.description: Every OTHER expanded_variants entry from this run's expanded_hypothesis_card.yaml -- none dropped, none duplicated, the selected one excluded.

variant_definition.description: The menu entry, copied verbatim by code -- either a dict or a bare string.

lost_reason.description: Best-effort, optional. Never fabricated if the source variant carried no lost_reason/why_it_lost field -- an absent reason means 'not chosen this round', not 'contraindicated'.
